title: Volvo increases the batteries for 2028 XC60 and XC90 plug-in refresh
gist: Volvo's refreshed XC60 and XC90 plug-in hybrids jump to a 37.9 kWh net battery, more than doubling EV range to 78 and 73 miles respectively — a 3.6x capacity increase over the 2018 XC60 PHEV's 10.4 kWh pack. Volvo is also adding XC60 production at its South Carolina plant explicitly because the current tariff regime has heavily incentivized local production, and is embedding Google's Gemini assistant into an 11.2-inch Android Automotive infotainment system.

insights.claim: The refreshed Volvo XC60 T8 plug-in hybrid carries a 37.9 kWh net (41.2 kWh gross) battery delivering 78 miles of EPA-rated electric range, versus 10.4 kWh and 17 miles on the 2018 version and 14.9 kWh and 35 miles at the 2023 refresh.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A 3.6x pack-size increase in eight years on a single PHEV nameplate means plug-in hybrids are now a material source of cell demand, not a rounding error versus BEVs.
insights.locator: The most significant change is invisible

insights.claim: The XC90 T8 receives the same 37.9 kWh usable battery, yielding 73 miles of all-electric range in the larger three-row SUV.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Sharing one large pack across nameplates is the cost lever that makes long-range PHEVs viable — watch for the same pack appearing across the rest of the lineup.
insights.locator: And the XC90 T8 plug-in gets the same larger 37.9 kWh usable battery

insights.claim: Volvo's own data shows the median US Volvo driver's commute is 22 miles round-trip, so the 78-mile pack covers roughly three days of daily driving on one charge.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Sizing packs to multi-day commute coverage rather than single-trip range reframes PHEV design targets — and reduces the charging-infrastructure dependency that constrains BEV adoption.
insights.locator: According to Volvo, that should be enough for three days' worth of daily driving

insights.claim: With a full battery and full fuel tank the XC60 T8 can cover 590 miles between stops, combining long electric commuting range with conventional road-trip capability.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: The dual-capability pitch is the core PHEV value proposition as BEV growth slows — a demand tailwind for cell suppliers serving hybrid programs.
insights.locator: With a full battery and a full tank of gas

insights.claim: Volvo will begin building the XC60 at its South Carolina plant in addition to the existing Swedish line, because the current tariff regime has heavily incentivized local production.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A concrete case of tariffs moving volume production onshore — supports US automotive capex, supplier localization and regional battery sourcing over imported assemblies.
insights.quote: The US is a big market for the XC60, and the current tariff regime has heavily incentivized local production.
insights.locator: Perhaps the other big news for the XC60

insights.claim: Volvo had sold more than 2.7 million XC60s worldwide by the end of last year, making it the company's bestselling model of all time and the volume anchor for any powertrain change.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Applying a 37.9 kWh pack to Volvo's highest-volume nameplate scales battery procurement sharply — a sizable contract opportunity for cell suppliers.
insights.locator: Volvo had sold more than 2.7 million XC60s worldwide

insights.claim: Volvo CEO Håkan Samuelsson positions the long-range XC60 and XC90 plug-ins alongside the all-electric EX60 as the company's strongest-ever electrified offering in the mid-size SUV segment and a path to full electrification for every customer.
insights.speaker: Håkan Samuelsson
insights.so_what: Management is hedging rather than committing to BEV-only — a signal that Volvo's electrification timeline now bends to demand reality, softening BEV volume forecasts.
insights.quote: Now, as long-range plug-in hybrids, they build on those legacies and, together with the all-electric EX60, give us our strongest-ever electrified offering in the mid-size SUV segment.
insights.locator: The XC60 is our bestselling model of all time

insights.claim: The refreshed XC60 and XC90 get an 11.2-inch infotainment system with a Gemini personal assistant enabling conversational voice control of the Android Automotive OS-based system.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Google embedding a frontier assistant directly into the vehicle OS deepens its position in automotive software — a recurring-revenue channel automakers are ceding.
insights.locator: the new 11.2-inch infotainment system sports a Gemini personal assistant

insights.claim: Brief testing showed the new Gemini voice assistant performs a lot better than the previous version, which if anything had degraded in ability over the past few years.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: The admission that the prior in-car assistant regressed over time is a warning that shipped automotive software can degrade — a durability risk for software-defined vehicle value claims.
insights.quote: the new Gemini voice assistant does at least perform a lot better than the previous version, which, if anything, has degraded in ability over the past few years

themes.theme: Styling and cadence of the refresh cycle

insights.claim: Volvo revealed the revised XC40 one day before the XC60 and XC90 updates, indicating a compressed, coordinated model-refresh cadence across the SUV lineup.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A lineup-wide refresh in a single week suggests a shared platform and software update — efficient capex, but it also concentrates execution risk in one cycle.
insights.quote: There must be a case of upgrade fever taking hold in Gothenburg.

insights.claim: XC60 styling changes are subtle — Thor's Hammer headlights keep their daytime running light signature but now conceal matrix LED projectors, alongside a slimmed grille and revised bumpers, wings and body panels, plus a new ventilated leather interior option.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Minimal sheet-metal change with a major powertrain upgrade is a low-capex refresh strategy — margin-protective but limits the pricing power a full redesign would allow.
insights.locator: Visually, there are changes to the Thor's Hammer headlights

insights.claim: The XC90 receives fewer styling updates than the XC40 and XC60 because it was recently updated itself, but still gains the new Gemini infotainment and the larger battery.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Decoupling powertrain and software updates from sheet-metal cycles is how legacy OEMs compete with software-first rivals without full redesign costs.
